The '''VX3 Scanner''' was a model of [[Binoculars/Legends|wide-scan binoculars]] produced by [[Jassim Design]]. They were available in the time period surrounding the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], and cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TotJC" />
